eligible_majors.notes: All majors except Digital Media & Journalism (subject to prerequisites on transcript).

excluded_majors.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1
excluded_majors.notes: Fact sheet page 1 explicitly states: 'the department of Digital Media & Journalism is NOT open to exchange and visiting due to lack of course availability for majors.'

min_gpa_host.notes: Spring 2026 fact sheet page 1 specifies 2.5 / 4.0 GPA or equivalent.

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1
english_course_availability.notes: All courses taught in English (ESL courses also available).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT 80 or IELTS 6.5 (no band score below 6.0); applicants who do not submit scores are tested upon arrival (ESL courses available).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=2

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Classes begin Aug 24, 2026; Thanksgiving Break Nov 25–27, 2026; Last day of classes Dec 7, 2026; Final Exams Dec 11–17, 2026.
fall_term_dates.notes: Earlier Fall 2025 fact sheet page 1 listed move-in/pickup Aug 19, Orientation Aug 20, Classes Aug 25 – Dec 18, 2025.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2026 (fact sheet): Airport pickup & move-in Jan 15, Orientation Jan 16, Classes Jan 21 – May 15, 2026 (Spring Break Mar 30 – Apr 3, 2026); Spring 2027 UG registration opens Nov 9, 2026.
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1

tuition_model.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=2
tuition_model.notes: Exchange students do not pay tuition ($9,180 tuition plus activity/athletic/technology fees waived by sponsor funds totaling $9,780/semester on page 3); students pay room, food service, college fee, health center fee, health insurance, and orientation fee.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=3
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Spring 2026 & Fall 2025 fact sheets page 3 itemize Room Rent ($5,880) + Food Service ($2,960) + Books ($660) + Personal Expenses ($1,780) = $11,280 USD/semester, prorated across a 5-month semester ($2,256 USD/month).

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=3
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: Room $5,880 + Food Service $2,960 + Books $660 + Personal $1,780 = $11,280 USD/semester ($2,256 USD/month * 5 months * 1.0 = $11,280 USD, 1 USD = 1.0 USD, checked 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Spring 2026 / Fall 2025 billed non-tuition fees: Health Insurance $1,130/semester, Health Center Fee $170/semester, College Fee $30/semester, one-time Orientation Fee $150 (plus on-campus Room $5,880 and Food Service $2,960).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=3

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=2
housing_availability.notes: Living on campus in Residence Halls (with meal plan) is strongly recommended; SUNY New Paltz is not involved with off-campus housing (https://www.newpaltz.edu/reslife/).

housing_notes.value: On-campus Residence Halls + meal plan strongly recommended ($5,880 room + $2,960 food service/semester in 2025-2026); university does not assist with off-campus housing.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=2

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor visa required (unless US citizen); DS-2019 requires demonstrating $12,760 USD Personal Funds for 1 semester (~$25,520 for Academic Year) covering room, meal plan, fees, insurance, books, and personal expenses.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=3
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Exact embassy processing lead time not stated.

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1
course_catalog_url.notes: Also full course descriptions at https://www.newpaltz.edu/ugc/ucourses.html and programs at https://www.newpaltz.edu/ugc/programs.html.

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit hours; minimum 12 credits/semester required for full-time & international student status (15 credits standard; up to 19 credits permitted).
credit_system_and_load.notes: Confirmed on newpaltz.edu academic credit load policies.

course_restrictions_note.value: Department of Digital Media & Journalism is closed to exchange students; all other areas open provided prerequisites are evidenced on transcript (popular courses include POL370 UN Semester, THE209, SAB353).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1

academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1
academic_style.notes: SUNY comprehensive public liberal arts college.

international_support_services.value: Official airport pick-up, mandatory Orientation, ESL courses, student organizations, and dedicated Inbound Exchange Advisor (pollardj@newpaltz.edu).
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: Nomination Mar 15 / Application Apr 15 (Fall 2025 sheet); Spring: Nomination Oct 15 / Application Nov 15 (Spring 2026 sheet; flexible by agreement).
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/SUNY - New Paltz/Spring 2026/New Paltz Fact sheet Spring 2026.pdf#page=1
